card.title: Helio support quality
card.what_to_watch: Weighted customer recontact quality across chat, email, and voice support.
card.why_watch: Suppress noise while surfacing a broad quality regression that support leadership should act on.
card.decision_guidance: Use the weighted rate across eligible conversations, not an unweighted average of channel percentages. Notify Support Quality when the weighted current rate is at least 9% or current minus the adjacent closed-week baseline is at least 2.5 percentage points. Ignore otherwise. If the Preset result is incomplete or not comparable, route insufficient_data to Support Data.
watch_for: A weighted current rate at or above 9%.
An increase of at least 2.5 percentage points versus the adjacent closed week.
An incomplete channel partition or unreconciled denominator.
questions: Is the weighted rate above the owner-defined threshold?
Is the comparison complete and comparable?
